sources.name: CREATE Medicines PRNewswire release
evidence: Early clinical data from the company's MT-303 program in frontline hepatocellular carcinoma
CREATE Medicines is a clinical-stage biotechnology company pioneering in vivo immune programming

sources.name: Rznomics PRNewswire release
evidence: the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has granted Regenerative Medicine Advanced Therapy (RMAT) Designation to RZ-001
RZ-001 previously received Orphan Drug Designation (ODD) in 2024 and Fast Track Designation (FTD) in 2025 for the treatment of HCC

sources.name: Can-Fite BioPharma SEC Exhibit 99.1
evidence: Can-Fite’s liver drug, Namodenoson, is being evaluated in a Phase III trial for hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC)
Fast Track Designation as a second line treatment for HCC by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration

sources.name: Coherus Oncology SEC Exhibit 99.1
evidence: Patient accrual complete for 1L HCC Phase 2 randomized clinical trial for anti-IL27 casdozokitug
timing for data readouts tracking to projections

sources.name: Tvardi Therapeutics SEC Exhibit 99.1
evidence: Topline data from Phase 2 trial of TTI-101 in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) on track for 2H 2026
Phase 1b/2 trial remains on track to report topline results in 2H 2026
